experiment: P0-1 full nested selection with fold-local ESM-2 PCA (iclr_improvement_plan_v2.md)

protocol.pca_dim_rule: d = min(20, n_train - 1), fit on training rows only, raw scores
protocol.scaling_primary: none (raw features; matches frozen fixed rows)
protocol.selection: inner LOO; tie-break (inner MAE, candidate list order, [model simplicity]); effective dimension is recorded but not used for tie-breaking
protocol.outer_eval: selected (candidate, model) refit on full training fold; single evaluation on held-out mutant

t7_pca20_fixed.note: GPU canonical (0.147749) and CPU rerun (0.145944) differ by 0.0018: known env-dependent ESM-2 numerics, recorded in benchmark_registry.json (8/4 value 0.1459 not reproducible in GPU venv; R4 GPU rerun = 0.147749, canonical). This run is CPU; tol check uses the CPU-reproducible value.

llr_proxy_fixed.note: frozen LLR row used a global scale; this row is fold-local

verification.tol_rule: abs_diff <= 1e-3 for every verification block; the t7 block contributes abs_diff_vs_cpu_repro per its note (CPU-reproducible reference). Boolean recomputed 2026-08-17 after fixing the aggregation to include the t7 block; measured values unchanged.
